# use-accessibility

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse accessibility facade.

## Facade links

- Canonical facade crate page: https://rustuse.org/use-accessibility/
- Facade overview page: https://rustuse.org/facades/use-accessibility/
- Workspace Rustdocs: https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-accessibility/
- Repository: https://github.com/RustUse/use-accessibility
- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Parent RustUse links

- Primary site: https://rustuse.org/
- Onboarding docs: https://rustuse.org/onboarding/
- Facade docs overview: https://rustuse.org/facades/
- Crate docs overview: https://rustuse.org/crates/
- Contributing: https://rustuse.org/contributing/
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/RustUse

## Workspace Rustdocs

- https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-accessibility/
- https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-accessibility/{crate_module}/index.html

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-accessibility/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-accessibility/llms-full.txt. The /facades/use-accessibility/ routes serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
